sourceReviewNote: H1 inventories repository statements and operational semantics at the declared snapshot. Primary literature currency, corrections, clinical applicability and republication rights remain for H2. A recorded statement is not endorsement.

concepts.label: Resting metabolic rate
concepts.definition: Energy expenditure under a specified resting measurement protocol; do not silently equate different preparation conditions.

concepts.label: Resting energy expenditure
concepts.definition: Resting energy endpoint with source-specific operational definition; map to RMR only after method review.

concepts.label: Total daily energy expenditure
concepts.definition: Whole-day expenditure endpoint, distinct from resting energy or an intake target.

concepts.label: Sedentary baseline
concepts.definition: Current model assumption allocating 1.2 times resting energy; not measured resting expenditure.

concepts.label: Incremental walking energy
concepts.definition: Modeled energy above the assumed included steps, with explicit stride and net-cost assumptions.

concepts.label: Workout energy
concepts.definition: Current whole-session MET estimate net of an allocated baseline; membership of steps remains separate.

concepts.label: Fat-free mass
concepts.definition: Nonfat body mass, with method and conditions required; not identical to skeletal muscle mass.

concepts.label: Skeletal muscle mass
concepts.definition: A component of FFM, not an independent calorie bonus or sufficient body-fat measurement.

concepts.label: Body-fat percentage
concepts.definition: A measured or estimated input whose method and uncertainty must be retained.
concepts.units: percentage points for changes; percent for levels

concepts.label: Training readiness
concepts.definition: Current heuristic classification; requires a specified outcome before predictive validation.

concepts.label: Caloric allowance
concepts.definition: A proposed goal-dependent intake decision, not equal to measured or estimated TDEE.

concepts.label: SDNN
concepts.definition: A specific HRV statistic; preserve measurement window and provider method.

concepts.label: RMSSD
concepts.definition: A distinct HRV statistic; not interchangeable with SDNN because units match.

concepts.label: Activity membership
concepts.definition: Evidence that a sample contributes to a defined aggregate; temporal overlap alone is insufficient.

concepts.label: Cohort confidence interval
concepts.definition: Sampling uncertainty for a defined aggregate under a resampling/analysis method.

concepts.label: Individual prediction interval
concepts.definition: Uncertainty for a new individual observation; requires evaluation of predictive coverage.

concepts.label: Body mass
concepts.definition: User-supplied body mass; measurement method and date are not captured by the current API.

concepts.label: Height
concepts.definition: User-supplied height; converted from cm to m for the stride proxy.

concepts.label: Age
concepts.definition: User-supplied age in years; permitted numeric bounds are a software contract, not evidence of suitability.

concepts.label: Equation sex parameter
concepts.definition: Binary male/female coefficient selection in the existing equation; does not represent a complete account of sex, gender, physiology or treatment.

concepts.label: Step count
concepts.definition: Daily step total supplied to the model; source, merge rules and reporting window are not recorded by the current API.

concepts.label: Stride proxy
concepts.definition: Height in meters multiplied by 0.415 in the current model; not directly observed distance per step.

concepts.label: Walking distance proxy
concepts.definition: Nonnegative steps above the assumed baseline multiplied by the stride proxy.

concepts.label: Workout duration
concepts.definition: Whole-session elapsed duration, including rest intervals under the documented intensity convention.

concepts.label: MET preset
concepts.definition: Illustrative whole-session activity factor; used with the approximate 1 kcal/kg/hour convention.

concepts.label: Sleep duration
concepts.definition: Supplied sleep hours; no device, window, sleep quality or clinical assessment is encoded.

concepts.label: Subjective state
concepts.definition: Categorical self-report of energy, soreness/pain or prior-week fatigue; not a diagnostic measurement.

concepts.label: Working sets
concepts.definition: Illustrative count per target muscle per session, based on the user-supplied usual count; not weekly volume.

concepts.label: Training performance outcome
concepts.definition: Proposed next-session task-specific outcome in the wearable protocol; not interchangeable with hypertrophy, injury or causal benefit.

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.definition: Recorded value with method, source, window and units; unknown metadata remain unknown. User entry alone does not establish direct measurement.

concepts.label: Model estimate
concepts.definition: Value derived from an equation or heuristic; separate from an observation and from an action recommendation.

concepts.label: Decision
concepts.definition: Action or deployment choice informed by evidence and values; accuracy or causal benefit requires separate evaluation.

concepts.label: Body-fat percentage-point change
concepts.definition: Absolute difference between two percent values; distinct from relative percent change.
